target_customer: Non-technical business and product teams at companies with analytics databases such as BigQuery
problem: Teams notice abnormal drops in revenue or product metrics too late because engineering monitoring tools do not cover business data.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for automated metric monitoring and Slack alerts

founders.name: Mark Wai
founders.background_notes: YC page says previously Growth at Tesla and Facebook.

founders.name: Victor Zhang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as co-founder of Cega, a later venture.

founders.name: Winston Zhang
founders.background_notes: The Launch HN post names Victor, Mark and Winston as founders.

competitors.name: Datadog, PagerDuty, Sentry
competitors.what: Engineering monitoring and alerting tools; the Orbiter launch framed business and product metrics as the unserved gap

technical_complexity.rationale: Automatic anomaly detection across arbitrary customer tables with five-minute onboarding required modeling and data connectors beyond a weekend build.

defensibility.rationale: Anomaly detection on warehouse data was easy for analytics vendors to add; no data or integration lock-in documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source records what incumbents did; the team later co-founded Cega.

market_need_then: The launch post said engineering teams had plenty of monitoring but business and product teams lacked tools to catch metric drops. No customer evidence found.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt Launch of the Day on 5 March 2020 and a Launch HN post; no merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with a space tug, a simulator and many Orbiter AI products; no brand assets found.

outcome_analysis: Orbiter launched on Product Hunt in March 2020, raised only a reported 150K dollars at the YC stage, and is now inactive with the founders moving to Cega. No post-mortem or news about its end was found, so the cause is not public. The brand_confusion label rests only on name collisions seen in searches, not on any stated cause, and is low confidence.
notes: The 150K seed rests on a single database (CB Insights) and is the YC investment. The Launch HN link is a blog repost of the original; Product Hunt URL is titled Orbiter AI and the identification with this company relies on the quoted launch text. No company website was listed. Datadog is cited as an adjacent engineering tool rather than a direct rival. Brand effect rated hurt is a low-confidence guess; revise if evidence appears.
